notes.title: 0.4.0 (Numerical turtleneck update)
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where score wasn't reset after selecting a level.
[*] Fixed speed of cars after selecting a level.
[/list]

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Power-ups now only appear behind cars, not in front of them.
[*] Points are now awarded for collecting power-ups.
[*] Turtles now swim side to side.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for 0.2.0 (Day one update)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added high score to HUD.
[*] Added a level select menu to continue from any level you've previously reached.
[*] Made the road more visually appealing with dark pavement and yellow dashed stripes.
[*] Add four new music tracks. Enjoy!
[*] Added an exit confirm dialog.
[*] Made slowmo power-up (star) less shiny and more glowy.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
